Location: Park Avenue Medical Centre

I called the surgery to book an appointment with my GP. The lady from administration spoke to me in a rude and dismissive way, as if I was bothering her. She told me I would be contacted between 2 and 4 p.m., but nobody called me.

It is very hard to get an appointment here, especially for working people. I start work at 6 a.m. and finish at 2 p.m. I asked politely to be contacted after 2, but she said it was “too late”. That’s unfair — people who work deserve access to medical care too.
